name: latex-codex
description: Local LaTeX editing and live PDF preview in the Codex browser side panel.

interface.shortDescription: Edit LaTeX and preview a locally compiled PDF.
interface.longDescription: A small local editor with automatic local TeX compilation and a bundled PDF.js viewer in the Codex browser side panel. Supports pdfLaTeX/XeLaTeX directives, BibTeX and SyncTeX. Requires Python 3, an existing TeX installation, and Poppler pdfinfo for page metadata. Pages render on demand in the browser.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open my LaTeX file with LaTeX Codex in the side panel.
